notes.title: ODDLI Demo Coming June 1st 🎉
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
  
We’re incredibly excited to announce that the [b]ODDLI demo[/b] will be launching on [b]June 1st[/b], just in time to warm up for [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]! 🎮✨
  
Whether you're into satisfying movement puzzles, adorable toylike characters, or cozy vibes with a clever twist — this one's for you.

  [h2]What is ODDLI?[/h2]  

[b]ODDLI[/b] is a [b]casual puzzle game[/b] about creating mesmerizing loops with your own movement.
  [list]    [*]Create your own ODDLI satisfying loops[/*]    [*]Explore surreal, handcrafted biomes[/*]    [*]Enjoy a calming original soundtrack[/*]    [*]Watch your characters repeat your every move[/*]  [/list]  
[h2]What to Expect in the Demo[/h2]  [list]    [*]10 Levels in 5 different environments + A secret endless level![/*]    [*]Bonus challenges and hidden stars[/*]    [*]A sneak peek at different game modes[/*]    [*]A polished slice of what’s coming later this year[/*]  [/list] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45499258/6e590d1150b941b1411e6aded8501d84865077cb.jpg[/img]

[h2]Available Early for Creators[/h2]  
Are you a content creator? Reach out on [url=https://www.oddligame.com/]our website[/url] to request early access.

[h2]Help Us Spread the Word[/h2]  [list]    [*]👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3484520/ODDLI_A_satisfying_game]Wishlist now![/url][/*]    [*]👉 Follow us for updates  [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@oddli.game]Tiktok[/url] [url=https://www.instagram.com/oddligame?igsh=NjZqNXJ3MWw3bDNm&utm_source=qr]Instagram[/url][/*] [*]👉 Tell a friend who loves cozy games![/*]  [/list]
Stay tuned — we can’t wait to see the loops you’ll create.
[b]– Team Tight Fit[/b]
